description: This is an Android application's main activity class for an Android TV frontend. The class `MainActivity` sets up the main UI, handles key events from the remote control, and prepares the activity for potential rating screen functionalities.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for Android TV frontend extending FragmentActivity and handling remote key events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and prepares the title text.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events from the remote control, such as OK, ENTER, and BACK buttons.
